title: Show keyboard shortcut for launching app next to app name
line: Kickoff now shows an app's launch shortcut, like Meta+E for Dolphin, at the end of its row.
explanation: Apps can have a global shortcut that launches them (Meta+E for Dolphin, Ctrl+Alt+T for Konsole, or one set in the Menu Editor or System Settings), but Kickoff never showed it, so the only way to find it was the Shortcuts page. The Kicker models had no data for it. The plasma-workspace commit adds a launchShortcut role to the apps, favorites, recent apps and search results models, read from kglobalaccel for the app's desktop file. The plasma-desktop commit shows it dimmed at the end of Kickoff's list rows, like shortcuts in menus.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: expose each app's launch shortcut to the models

Launchers had no way to show the global shortcut that starts an app, so
users had to open System Settings to find it. Add a launchShortcut role
for apps in the apps, favorites, recent and search results models.

BUG: 508895

applets/kickoff: show each app's launch shortcut next to its name

When an app has a global shortcut that launches it, list items didn't
show it anywhere. Show it dimmed at the end of the row, like shortcuts
in menus, so people can learn them right from the launcher.

BUG: 508895

patches.diff:
From 6df05ac5058a057a966d626999f9f3b089c938f9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:02:15 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff: show each app's launch shortcut next to its
 name

When an app has a global shortcut that launches it, list items didn't
show it anywhere. Show it dimmed at the end of the row, like shortcuts
in menus, so people can learn them right from the launcher.

BUG: 508895
---
 applets/kickoff/KickoffListDelegate.qml | 9 +++++++++
 1 file changed, 9 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/KickoffListDelegate.qml b/applets/kickoff/KickoffListDelegate.qml
index 4e3d57fab4..0ce8c66e1d 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/KickoffListDelegate.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/KickoffListDelegate.qml
@@ -109,6 +109,15 @@ AbstractKickoffItemDelegate {
             }
         }
 
+        PC3.Label {
+            visible: text.length > 0 && !root.isCategoryListItem && !root.removalPlaceholderActive
+            opacity: 0.75
+            text: root.model?.launchShortcut ?? ""
+            textFormat: Text.PlainText
+            verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
+            color: gridLayout.textColor
+        }
+
         Loader {
             Layout.preferredWidth: root.isCategoryListItem ? Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing : implicitWidth
             Layout.preferredHeight: root.isCategoryListItem ? Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing : implicitHeight
--

media.caption: System category on master: Dolphin has Meta+E but nothing shows it.
With the fix: Meta+E at the end of Dolphin's row.
Searching "system mon" on master (compact mode): no shortcut.
With the fix: System Monitor's Meta+Esc in the search result.
Favorites as a list, compact mode, on master; Dolphin's shortcut changed to Meta+Shift+D.
With the fix: Dolphin shows the new Meta+Shift+D, System Settings its default Tools key.
